scope: Independent read-only review of root agent.py/llm.py integration and config owner global hooks. Other prompt/effort/code-syntax/redaction changes are outside this finding.

boundaries.check: Text, tool-call JSON and tool-response text encoded only in returned Weave Message copies; original provider request messages/output blocks remain unmodified.

Conversation title, question, system instructions, verifier payload/output, both tool arguments/results paths and final answer encoded once in tracing copies. Evidence/actions/provider feedback retain originals.
Client-wide URI codec applies after existing per-Op redaction; no per-Op telemetry codec added, so built-in Evaluation/legacy outputs are covered without duplicate encoding.
True SDK references preserved by helper; live fixture confirms actual typed reference reconstruction and original caller input/return values unchanged.

limitations: Telemetry helper decoding is exact-once at the corresponding stored value layer; apply only to records known to use this codec.
Readback helpers comparing tool argument JSON must restore_trace_value after json.loads; those comparing text must decode at the relevant trace_text or trace_json layer.

This fixture proves literal text/reference serialization and delivered linkage for the recorded source. It does not prove answer quality, real provider behavior, or remediation of the separate nested-JSON credential-redaction defect.
